clues: This town sits in the south of Los Angeles County, in California. It is a coast city, south of the city of Los Angeles.
On summer nights, low clouds and fog roll in and cover the city. By mid day, a sea wind from the west clears them and keeps the air mild.
This city was made a city in law in the year 1897. It sits in a group of towns called the Gateway Cities.
Race cars roar through city streets here in a Grand Prix meet. It is a race in the IndyCar series, known by car fans far and wide.
A famed old ocean ship, the RMS Queen Mary, is tied up here for good. It is one of the top sights on the waterfront.
